retirement_age.notes: Public-service retirement is at age 60 or 35 years of service, whichever comes first. Other groups differ: teachers 65 (raised from 60 in 2022), non-academic university staff 65, professors and judicial officers 70 (per the sources found). The Pension Reform Act 2014 lets holders of a retirement savings account access benefits from age 50. Nigeria has no single national old-age pension age; statutory is set to the general public-service age, not the highest occupational age.
